title: FORGETMENOT: Auditing Memory Driven Privacy Risks in Commercial AI Agents
title_zh: FORGETMENOT：审计商用 AI 智能体的记忆隐私风险
abstract_en: Commercial AI agents increasingly incorporate long-term memory (both persistent and chat-history) to enable more accurate and personalized responses, raises significant privacy and policy concerns. Yet little is known about user privacy risks associated with memory behavior, in particular, about memory storage, disclosure, transparency and deletion control. To bridge this gap, we propose FORGETMENOT, an auditing framework for analyzing the privacy risks of long term memory in commercial AI agents. Using our framework, we collect around 3800 multi-turn sessions comprising around 6M tokens across five popular AI agents. Our results show that agents store a wide range of personal attributes, including demographics, health, and sensitive details. Furthermore, user visible memory reveals substantially less (around 20% on average) attributes than the agents store in practice, exposing a significant transparency gap. Our stealth memory injection (SMI) technique further increases the amount of personal and sensitive attribute stored in memory, raising it by 25% and 15% for Copilot and Claude, respectively. We further observed memory deletion control is unreliable, as all five agents exhibit non-zero post deletion leakage, including health and self-harm related attributes. Finally, we demonstrate the feasibility of memory disclosure to a 3rd-party email recipient as a proof-of-concept, as Gemini shows 31.9% leakage rate. Together, our findings reveal notable privacy risks in commercial agents memory. Finally, we discuss both design implications and regulatory recommendations to protect users memory privacy in commercial agents.
abstract_zh: 商用 AI 智能体借助长期记忆（持久记忆和聊天历史）提供更准确、更个性化的回答，但用户难以了解哪些信息被保存、如何被披露，以及删除是否有效。本文提出审计框架 FORGETMENOT，对五款主流商用 AI 智能体开展评估，采集约 3,800 个多轮会话，共约 600 万个 token。结果显示，智能体会记住人口统计、健康等个人属性及其他敏感信息，而用户可见的记忆条目平均只覆盖实际存储属性的约 20%。隐蔽记忆注入（stealth memory injection, SMI）使 Copilot 和 Claude 存储的个人及敏感属性数量分别增加 25% 和 15%。五款智能体在删除记忆后均出现信息泄露，涉及健康和自伤相关属性。在向第三方邮件收件人披露记忆的概念验证中，Gemini 的泄露率为 31.9%。作者据此讨论了改善记忆透明度和删除控制的设计与监管建议。
key_points_zh: FORGETMENOT 从存储、披露、透明度和删除控制四个方面审计五款商用 AI 智能体。
用户可见的记忆平均只覆盖实际存储属性的约 20%，难以反映智能体记住了什么。
SMI 使 Copilot 和 Claude 存储的个人及敏感属性数量分别增加 25% 和 15%。
五款智能体在删除记忆后均有信息泄露，泄露内容包括健康和自伤相关属性。
在第三方邮件披露的概念验证中，Gemini 的记忆泄露率为 31.9%。

agent-memory.reason: 核心贡献是审计文本代理如何跨会话存储、披露和删除用户信息，而非提出新记忆机制。研究以罕见的合成属性作为核验基准，在五款代理上比较不同记忆设置，并通过删除后复测检验残留披露。结果支持将可见记忆检查与删除后的跨会话验证分开进行，但黑盒结果不能确定残留信息的存储位置。
